title: Data table with sort, filter, and row actions
description: A dense tabular component for comparing records: sortable column headers, a filter row or toolbar, column-appropriate alignment and formatting, row selection with bulk actions, and per-row actions. Includes loading, empty, no-results, and error states and keeps the header visible while scrolling.
intent: Let users scan, compare, sort, and act on many records without leaving the table.
characteristics: semantic table with header cells and aria-sort on the sorted column
numbers right-aligned in tabular numerals; text left-aligned
sticky header and optional sticky first column
selection checkbox column with bulk action bar
explicit loading, empty, no-results, and error rows
interaction: Sort cycles ascending, descending, none via the header button; filters apply on change with debounce for text; bulk action bar appears when rows are selected and states the count; row actions live in a menu button per row.
responsive: The table scrolls horizontally inside a labeled, focusable region with a sticky first column; below a breakpoint, an optional card list view shows the key columns.
accessibility: Sort controls are buttons inside th; aria-sort only on the active column; selection checkboxes labeled by row name; the scroll container has tabindex="0" and an accessible name; avoid role="grid" unless implementing full grid keyboard navigation.
limitations: Not a spreadsheet: in-cell editing and full grid keyboard navigation need a separate pattern.
Very large datasets need server-side sort/filter and virtualization, which changes the a11y approach.
